The learned Counsel for the Plaintiffs submitted that in May 2025, the Plaintiffs received information through their market sources that Defendant No. 1 is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of tobacco products bearing the Marks 'AL SHAHIN' and 'SHAHIN' ("Impugned Trade Marks").

Upon receiving this information about Defendant No. 1's unauthorised use of an identical Mark to the Plaintiffs' Trade Marks, the Plaintiffs hired a private investigator to find more information about the business activities of Defendant No. 1.

The investigator in an online search on, www.google.com,
